Name: Kenneth's Dinner Time
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Gives your farmer dinner every night, after a long day at the farm.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]I made this because I like the idea of ending the day with a proper meal before heading to bed.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It is a different dinner each day, with rice and water on the side. 28 different dinners in total, one for each day of the month, and it loops when the next month starts.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Dinner is available from 8pm to 9:59pm. Go outside during that time and it will be in your bag. If you are already sleeping and miss it, you wait for the next day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]If your bag is full, check the lost and found at the mayor's house.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works on new or existing saves. Sleep one night after installing and it will start the next day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You will need Kenneth's Hearty Breakfast and Grill, Restaurant, and Drink Shop, plus SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Safe to add or remove anytime.[/b][/size]
